steps.title: Memory entry types
steps.note: CoworkMemoryEntry is scoped by userId and optionally by projectId or sessionId. The type enum lets agents distinguish facts, preferences, skills, and general context.

steps.title: Persona shape
steps.note: A CoworkPersona belongs to a user, carries a system prompt, declares allowed tools, and has an isDefault flag. The store guarantees one default per user.

steps.title: Built-in personas
steps.note: The engine seeds Researcher, Engineer, and Analyst personas. Engineer is marked isDefault: true so workspaces always have a fallback specialist.
